fields.Name: T098 - Chat Global Search Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the in-app SearchPanelComponent that searches across conversations/messages/artifacts/collections/tasks with scoped filters — distinct from Explorer's global Ctrl+K command palette.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "Filtering the conversation list offers a 'Search all of Chat for …' row, and clicking it opens the Chat search panel with the typed term and the multi-entity placeholder text",
    "Filter buttons (All / Conversations / Messages / Artifacts / Collections / Tasks) render and highlight when selected",
    "Typing produces results or a valid empty/no-results state, and the panel closes via X or Escape",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
